col.brandHint: The label on the garment — not the customer.
col.invoicedHint: Issued invoices less credit notes, by pieces; drafts and deposit invoices do not count.
col.openUnitsHint: Pieces the order still owes (none once shipped, closed or cancelled)
col.progressHint: Cut, sewn and finished of the pieces in work orders (read only while this column is shown)
col.balanceHint: Still to pay: the gross less credit notes and what is paid
col.noteHint: The office’s own note: the customer never sees it
col.atRiskHint: The promise is near and the order is still being made (the alert rule’s days)
col.customerUrgencyHint: The customer's own order of its urgent orders, read-only: never a place in our plan. Our own Priority shows beside it when it is not Normal.
col.whereItIsHint: The stage and the health, then the one thing that stops the order or who it waits on; under them this order's own pieces (read only while this column is shown)
col.waitingOnHint: The most urgent: a request to answer, a reply that waits on us, who acts next
col.supervisorHint: Me, someone else or not set: never a name on a list
col.brandPriceHint: The customer's own price for this order, without VAT (its PO or the portal)
col.priceMatchHint: Our price beside the customer's, line by line, without VAT: Equal, Not equal or No customer price yet
col.priceDiffHint: Our price minus the customer's: + we ask more, − we ask less
